reapack.name: reaper_reacord.ext
reapack.desc: ReaCord: Discord Rich Presence for REAPER

version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Logo Customization Release: + Profile Card Logo selection: choose between Classic REAPER guitar pick and ReaCord hybrid emblem + Configurable in both native SWELL dialog and ReaImGui companion

version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Security & Asset Release: + Security hardening: named pipe client impersonation defense (SECURITY_SQOS_PRESENT) + Safe bounded memory allocation for incoming IPC frames + Thread-local string buffers for ReaScript C API exports + Robust numeric sanitization for custom Discord Client IDs + Compiler & linker exploit mitigations (ASLR, DEP, Control Flow Guard, Stack Canaries) + New official diagonal-split ReaCord emblem combining REAPER and Discord + Terms of Service & Privacy Policy for Discord Developer Portal verification

version.author: Bartek Staniak
version.changelog: Initial Release: + Native C++ Discord Rich Presence extension for REAPER + Zero external processes required + Granular privacy controls (Project Name, Session Time, Play State, Track Count) + Instant Incognito stealth mode + Dual GUI: Native SWELL dialog + ReaImGui live preview companion + Ultra-lightweight asynchronous architecture with zero audio latency impact
